contexts.text: The (Antediluvian) men were bristly and hairy.
With many no faces appear, but in place thereof somewhat hairy, or bony.
If they are unchaste the new-comers are changed, and appear before the eyes of the Angels hairy...
Melancthon appeared clothed in a hairy skin, because faith without charity is cold.
Some of (the Babylonians) appear bald; some altogether hairy. They who were bald were they who were inmostly in evils; they who were hairy, who were altogether in falsities.
